notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four Elves.
Wirewood Channeler and Niblis do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Niblis by paying {U} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Niblis' ability, targeting Wirewood Channeler.
Resolve both Niblis abilities, untapping Niblis and Wirewood Channeler.
Repeat.
